ActivityData.doc:
One entry of the workbook's activity log: what was done, when. Keyed by
`"{at:020}|{author}|{nonce}"`; its author is the entry's owner stamp, and a
"since" query is a seek on the `at` index.

fields.name: sheet_id
fields.doc: Empty for workbook-level actions (a named range).

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: `cells`, `rows`, `cols`, `sheet` or `name`.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: How many cells changed; `changes` holds at most [`MAX_LOGGED_CHANGES`].

ActivityEntry.doc: An activity-log entry, newest first from `get_activity`.

AlertState.doc:
Which cells of an alert rule met its condition when last checked, so it
tells only about cells that start meeting it. Keyed by rule id.

AttachmentData.doc:
A file attached to a cell. The bytes are a blob in the node's blob store,
announced to this context so members' nodes can fetch it; this is its
record. Keyed by id, owned by whoever attached it (`attachments`).

AxisData.doc:
One row or column added to a sheet, or one deleted. Keyed by
`"{sheet_id}|r|{id}"` / `"{sheet_id}|c|{id}"`; see the recalc crate's
`layout` module for how entries order a sheet.

fields.name: pos
fields.doc: Fractional position: decimal digits, compared as strings.

AxisEntryView.doc: One explicit row or column entry of a sheet.

AxisOp.doc:
A structural edit: add a row or column at a fractional position, delete
one by id, or restore a deleted one (an undo). Every op is one write,
however many cells the sheet holds.

AxisSize.doc: A row's or column's size: `axis` is `row` or `col`.

Cell.doc:
A cell, by row and column id. An implicit id is a 0-based position
(`"3"` is the fourth row until rows move); the client places ids with the
sheet's layout (`get_layouts`).

fields.name: raw_value
fields.doc: As stored: references name rows and columns by id.

fields.name: last_editor
fields.doc:
Member id of whoever last changed the cell; empty for a cell last
written before the activity log existed.

CellChange.doc:
One cell's change within an activity entry: its raw value and format
before and after.

CellData.doc:
A cell's value, stored in the shared UnorderedMap under
`"{sheet_id}|{row_id}|{col_id}"`. Its format is a separate field
(`formats`), so a value edit and a format edit never overwrite each other.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Mirrors the map key for ABI convenience.

fields.name: raw_value
fields.doc: Raw user input (may be a formula like `=SUM(A1:A5)`).

CellMeta.doc: Who last changed a cell and when, keyed like the cell.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: Member id (`whoami`).

ChartData.doc: A chart of a range, anchored on corner row and column ids. Keyed by id.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: `bar` or `line`.

ChartInput.doc:
A chart as written or read: its range by corner ids, its kind and title.
The range's first column labels the points; each other column is a
series, named by the first row when that row is text.

CommentData.doc:
A comment on a cell, or a reply to one. Keyed by comment id, owned by its
author (`comments`). Whether its thread is resolved is kept apart
(`resolved`), since anyone may resolve and only the author edits.

fields.name: mentions
fields.doc: Member ids named with `@nickname` in the text.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: The comment this replies to; empty for a thread's first comment.

FormatData.doc:
A cell's display format, kept apart from its value so that formatting a
cell and typing in it at the same moment both survive. Keyed like the cell.

fields.name: format
fields.doc: Empty means Automatic, and overrides a format the cell carried from v1.

Founding.doc:
What a workbook is from the moment it exists: its id and creation time,
fixed in `init` and changeable by nobody (`founding`).

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Also the linked sheet's id.

LinkedData.doc:
A range pushed here from another workbook (the receiving side of a link),
shown as a read-only sheet whose id is the key. Values are row-major.

fields.name: blocked
fields.doc: Removed here: later pushes are ignored.

fields.name: deleted
fields.doc: Withdrawn by the source.

Member.doc: One collaborator, by the name they chose.

fields.name: id
fields.doc:
Account hex (`whoami`) — the same key `Cursor.author` carries, so a
roster and the live cursors join on it without a translation step.

fields.name: account
fields.doc:
The member's account (hex), as core's group roster names them: the
same value as `id`.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: `owner`, `editor`, `commenter` or `viewer`.

MemberData.doc:
A collaborator's chosen nickname, in their account's own slot (`members`),
so only they can set it.

This exists because the only thing the app could previously put next to a
cursor was a raw 64-hex device key, which answers no question anyone has.
A nickname has to live HERE and not in `localStorage`: localStorage is
per-browser, so a name kept there is visible to exactly the one person who
does not need it.

fields.name: joined_at
fields.doc:
First time this member announced themselves. Earliest wins on merge — a
later rename must not look like a later arrival.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: A reference in stored form.

NamedRangeData.doc:
A named range: a name that formulas can use in place of a reference.
Keyed by the upper-case name; an empty target means deleted (a removed key
would tombstone the name and block defining it again).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The name as it was typed, for display.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: A reference in stored form (`[sheet-id]!A1:B9`).

NoteChange.doc:
One step of a note edit, in the Quill delta shape: keep, insert or delete
characters, with formatting on kept or inserted text. Mirrors `DeltaOp`,
which has no `AbiType`.

NotedCell.doc: A cell that has a note, with the start of its text.

Project.doc:
The project's own identity, as the UI titles it.

`init_project` has always written `project_name`, and until now NOTHING
could read it back — there was no view method over the register at all. That
is the whole reason the workspace list fell back to names cached in
`localStorage`, which meant every peer but the creator saw "Workspace 1".

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Fixed when the workbook is created.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Empty until `init_project` runs.

ProtectionData.doc:
A protected range: only owners and the listed editors may change its cells.
Corners are row and column ids, so the range follows its cells as rows and
columns move; all four empty protects the whole sheet. Keyed by id.

fields.name: editors
fields.doc: Member ids allowed to edit it besides owners.

PublicationData.doc:
A range this workbook pushes to another workbook in the workspace (the
source side of a link). Keyed by id, owned by whoever linked it.

fields.name: target_context
fields.doc: The receiving workbook's context id, hex.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: What the linked sheet is called there.

RuleData.doc:
A conditional format, colour scale or validation over a range, anchored on
corner row and column ids like a protected range. Keyed by id.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: `format`, `scale` or `validate`.

fields.name: style
fields.doc: The style a matching `format` rule applies, as (field, value) pairs.

fields.name: strict
fields.doc: A `validate` rule that refuses values instead of marking them.

fields.name: recipients
fields.doc: Who an `alert` rule tells (member ids).

RuleInput.doc: A rule as written or read: its range by corner ids, and what it does.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc:
`format` (style cells that meet the condition), `scale` (shade numbers
from `args[0]` at the lowest to `args[1]` at the highest), `validate`
(values must meet the condition) or `alert` (tell `recipients` when a
value starts meeting it).

fields.name: linked_from
fields.doc:
For a linked sheet (read-only, pushed from another workbook), that
workbook's name; empty otherwise.

SheetData.doc: A sheet tab stored in the shared UnorderedMap.

fields.name: position
fields.doc: Tab ordering hint (lower = further left).

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: Timestamp of the last rename — used for LWW name merge.

SheetLayout.doc:
A sheet's explicit row and column entries. A sheet with none has the
implicit layout: row id `k` at row `k`.

SheetView.doc: A sheet's frozen rows and columns and resized rows and columns.

SheetViewData.doc: How a sheet is shown: its frozen rows and columns. Keyed by sheet id.

SizeData.doc: A resized row or column. Keyed `"{sheet_id}|r|{id}"` or `"{sheet_id}|c|{id}"`.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Pixels.

fields.name: founding
fields.doc: The workbook's id and creation time, fixed in `init`.

fields.name: project_name
fields.doc:
The workbook's name, set by `init_project`; empty until then. Only
owners write it.

fields.name: acl
fields.doc:
Workbook roles. Its admins are the owners; `viewer` and `commenter`
are named roles. A member with neither and not an owner is an editor.

fields.name: sheets
fields.doc: Sheet tabs keyed by sheet id.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc:
Cell values keyed by `"{sheet_id}|{row_id}|{col_id}"`, so one sheet's
cells are one prefix.

fields.name: members
fields.doc: Chosen nicknames, one slot per account that only it writes.

fields.name: axes
fields.doc:
Added and deleted rows and columns, keyed `"{sheet_id}|r|{id}"` and
`"{sheet_id}|c|{id}"`.

fields.name: formats
fields.doc: Cell formats, keyed like `cells`.

fields.name: names
fields.doc: Named ranges keyed by upper-case name.

fields.name: cell_meta
fields.doc: Who last changed each cell, keyed like `cells`.

fields.name: activity
fields.doc: The activity log: each entry owned by its author and never changed.

fields.name: comments
fields.doc:
Cell comments and replies, keyed by comment id: the author edits and
deletes, owners (the moderators) delete.

fields.name: resolved
fields.doc:
Whether a comment's thread is resolved, keyed by comment id. Anyone
in the workbook may resolve, so it is not part of the comment.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc:
Cell notes, keyed like `cells`: rich text that merges concurrent edits
character by character.

fields.name: protections
fields.doc: Protected ranges, keyed by id. Only owners write them.

fields.name: sizes
fields.doc: Resized rows and columns, keyed like `axes`.

fields.name: views
fields.doc: Frozen rows and columns per sheet.

fields.name: styles
fields.doc: Cell styles, keyed like `cells`.

fields.name: rules
fields.doc: Conditional formats, colour scales and validations, keyed by id.

fields.name: charts
fields.doc: Charts, keyed by id.

fields.name: attachments
fields.doc:
Files attached to cells, keyed by id: whoever attached one removes
it, and owners (the moderators) may.

fields.name: publications
fields.doc:
Ranges this workbook pushes to others, keyed by id: whoever linked
one stops it, and owners (the moderators) may.

fields.name: linked
fields.doc: Ranges pushed here from other workbooks, keyed by linked sheet id.

fields.name: alert_state
fields.doc: Alert rules' last matching cells, keyed by rule id.

StyleData.doc:
A cell's style, one last-writer-wins value per field, so one person
making a cell bold and another colouring it both keep their change.
Keyed like `cells`.

fields.name: fields
fields.doc: One entry per field, sorted by field. An empty value is a cleared field.

StyleOp.doc: One style change: set `field` of a cell to `value` (empty clears it).

methods.name: add_attachment
methods.doc:
Record a file attached to a cell. Upload the bytes as a blob announced
to this context first; this stores what the cell shows. Returns its id.

methods.name: add_chart
methods.doc: Chart a range. Returns the chart's id.

methods.name: add_comment
methods.doc:
Comment on a cell, or reply to a comment (`parent`). `@nickname` in the
text mentions that member: the `CommentAdded` event carries their ids,
and their client tells them. Returns the comment id.

methods.name: add_rule
methods.doc: Add a conditional format, colour scale or validation. Returns its id.

methods.name: apply_axis_ops
methods.doc:
Insert or delete rows and columns. Each op is one write, whatever the
sheet holds: cells keep their keys, and formulas that name rows by id
keep pointing at the same cells. A deleted row's cells stay stored but
out of the layout, so references to them read `#REF!`.

The client picks ids (letters first, never an implicit number) and
positions (see the recalc crate's `layout`).

methods.name: apply_cell_ops
methods.doc:
Apply a batch of cell operations to one sheet in a single mutation, with
ONE `CellsChanged` event for the whole batch.

At most [`MAX_OPS_PER_APPLY`] ops. One execution has a fixed gas budget
(1e9 points on 0.11.0-rc.43), and a batch that exhausts it fails as a
whole with nothing written. Refusing early says why; callers split
larger range ops.

methods.name: apply_private_cell_ops
methods.doc: Write cells of a private sheet: the same ops as `apply_cell_ops`.

methods.name: apply_style_ops
methods.doc:
Change cells' styles: bold, italic, underline, strike, wrap (`1`),
color and fill (`#rrggbb`), align (`left`, `center`, `right`); an
empty value clears the field. Each field merges on its own.

methods.name: create_private_sheet
methods.doc: Make a private sheet on this node. Returns its id.

methods.name: delete_comment
methods.doc:
Delete a comment. Its author or an owner may; storage refuses anyone
else on every node.

methods.name: delete_private_sheet
methods.doc: Delete a private sheet and its cells.

methods.name: drop_link
methods.doc: The source withdrew a link: remove its sheet.

methods.name: edit_comment
methods.doc:
Change a comment's text. Only its author may: storage refuses anyone
else's edit on every node.

methods.name: edit_note
methods.doc:
Edit a cell's note: one editor transaction (text and formatting) in the
Quill delta shape, counted against the note as this node holds it.
Concurrent edits from others merge character by character. Formatting
keys are `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `code`, `highlight`
and `link`.

methods.name: export_all
methods.doc:
Returns all sheets (same as list_sheets). The frontend assembles CSV
by calling get_cells per sheet.

methods.name: get_activity
methods.doc:
Activity since `since` (nanoseconds), newest first, at most `limit`
(capped at 500) entries: one seek on the `at` index. The author is the
entry's owner stamp.

methods.name: get_all_cells
methods.doc:
Every non-blank cell across all sheets, raw and computed: the client's
warm store, read in one call.

methods.name: get_attachments
methods.doc: Every attachment, oldest first. `created_by` is the owner stamp.

methods.name: get_cells
methods.doc:
One sheet's cells with computed values. Reads and evaluates only the
sheet and the sheets it transitively references, which gives the same
values as evaluating the whole workbook.

methods.name: get_charts
methods.doc: Every live chart.

methods.name: get_comments
methods.doc: Every comment, oldest first. The author is the entry's owner stamp.

methods.name: get_functions
methods.doc: Every formula function, sorted by name.

methods.name: get_layouts
methods.doc: Every sheet's explicit row and column entries.

methods.name: get_links
methods.doc: Every live link into this workbook.

methods.name: get_members
get_named_ranges
methods.doc: Every defined named range, sorted by name.

methods.name: get_note
methods.doc: A cell's note as formatted runs; empty when it has none.

methods.name: get_noted_cells
methods.doc: Every cell with a non-empty note, with the start of its text.

methods.name: get_private_cells
methods.doc:
Every cell of this node's private sheets. `computed_value` is empty:
the client evaluates them, with the shared sheets they read.

methods.name: get_private_sheets
methods.doc: This node's private sheets, in the order they were made.

methods.name: get_project
methods.doc:
The project's id, name and creation time.

New. `init_project` wrote the name into `project_name` from the first
version of this contract and no method ever read it, so the name was
replicated to every peer and visible to none of them.

Never 404s: an unnamed project is a real, transient state (a context
exists the moment it is created, `init_project` lands a round-trip
later) and it answers with an empty name so a caller can render a
placeholder instead of an error.

methods.name: get_protections
methods.doc: Every live protected range.

methods.name: get_publications
methods.doc: Every live link from this workbook: those an editor or owner made.

methods.name: get_rules
methods.doc: Every live rule.

methods.name: get_sheet_views
methods.doc:
Every sheet's frozen panes and resized rows and columns (sheets with
neither are left out).

methods.name: get_styles
methods.doc: Every styled cell, with its set fields.

methods.name: init_project
methods.doc:
Name the workbook, once. Owners only; the creator is the first owner.
Returns the workbook's id, fixed when it was created.

methods.name: join
methods.doc:
Announce this member under a chosen nickname, or rename it.

Idempotent by design — it is called on every open, not only on the first
one, because there is no reliable "first" for a replicated context and a
join that only registers once leaves anyone whose first attempt failed
permanently anonymous. `joined_at` is preserved across re-calls so a
rename does not reorder the roster.

methods.name: protect_range
methods.doc:
Protect a range (corner row and column ids; all four empty for the
whole sheet). Only owners and `editors` may then change its cells.
Owners only. Returns the protection id.

methods.name: publish_range
methods.doc:
Link a range to another workbook (its context id, hex), where it
appears as a read-only sheet called `name`. Returns the link's id.

methods.name: push_publication
methods.doc: Push a link's values again now.

methods.name: receive_link
methods.doc:
Receive a linked range from another workbook running this app. Only
the node calls it, from the source's `xcall`; the origin it sets must
be the workbook the call says it is from.

methods.name: remove_attachment
methods.doc:
Remove an attachment. Whoever attached it, or an owner, may: storage
refuses anyone else on every node.

methods.name: remove_protection
methods.doc: Remove a protection. Owners only.

methods.name: set_cell_format
methods.doc:
Set only the display format of a cell, preserving its value. `format`
is a keyword like "number"/"currency"/"percent"/"date" ("" = Automatic).

methods.name: set_comment_resolved
methods.doc: Resolve or reopen a comment thread. Anyone in the workbook may.

methods.name: set_frozen
methods.doc: Freeze the first `rows` rows and `cols` columns of a sheet (0 unfreezes).

methods.name: set_named_range
methods.doc: Define or redefine a named range. `target` is a reference in stored form.

methods.name: set_role
methods.doc:
Set a member's workbook role: `owner`, `editor`, `commenter` or
`viewer`. Owners only.

methods.name: set_sizes
methods.doc: Resize rows and columns (`axis` `row` or `col`, size in pixels).

methods.name: unlink
methods.doc: Remove a linked sheet here; later pushes of it are ignored.

methods.name: unpublish
methods.doc:
Stop a link, and remove its sheet from the other workbook. Whoever
linked it, or an owner, may: storage refuses anyone else.

methods.name: update_chart
methods.doc: Replace a chart's range, kind or title.

methods.name: update_protection
methods.doc: Change who may edit a protected range, and its description. Owners only.

methods.name: update_rule
methods.doc: Replace a rule.

methods.name: whoami
methods.doc:
The id THIS caller is known by in here — the key its cursor is authored
by and its roster row is stored under.

Exists so the frontend never has to guess which row is "me". It had been
comparing `Cursor.author` against the context's executor public key,
which is a different value from a different family: a device key and a
context identity are both 64 hex, so the comparison type-checks, returns
false forever, and shows the local user as a stranger in their own
spreadsheet. Asking the contract costs one read and cannot be wrong.

events.name: AlertTriggered
events.doc: Cells in an alert rule's range started meeting its condition.

events.name: AttachmentsChanged
events.doc: A file was attached to a cell, or removed.

events.name: AxesChanged
events.doc: Rows or columns were inserted or deleted via `apply_axis_ops`.

events.name: CellCleared
events.doc: A cell was cleared.

events.name: CellUpdated
events.doc: A cell's value was set or updated.

events.name: CellsChanged
events.doc:
A batch of cells was applied via `apply_cell_ops`. ONE event per batch
(not one per cell) so a large batch stays under the runtime's per-commit
event cap (`max_events`); subscribers refresh once for the whole apply.

events.name: ChartsChanged
events.doc: A chart was added, changed or removed.

events.name: CommentAdded
events.doc: A comment or reply was added; `mentions` are the member ids it names.

events.name: CommentChanged
events.doc: A comment was edited, resolved, reopened or deleted.

events.name: LinkedChanged
events.doc: A linked sheet (pushed from another workbook) arrived, changed or went.

events.name: MemberJoined
events.doc: A device announced itself under a nickname for the first time.

events.name: MemberRenamed
events.doc: A member changed the nickname they are shown under.

events.name: NamedRangesChanged
events.doc: A named range was defined, redefined or deleted.

events.name: NoteChanged
events.doc: A cell's note was edited.

events.name: ProjectInitialized
events.doc: A new spreadsheet project was initialized.

events.name: ProtectionsChanged
events.doc: A protected range was added, changed or removed.

events.name: PublicationsChanged
events.doc: A link from this workbook was made or stopped.

events.name: RolesChanged
events.doc: A member's workbook role changed.

events.name: RulesChanged
events.doc: A conditional format, colour scale or validation changed.

events.name: SheetCreated
events.doc: A new sheet tab was created.

events.name: SheetDeleted
events.doc: A sheet (and all its cells) was deleted.

events.name: SheetRenamed
events.doc: A sheet was renamed.

events.name: SheetViewChanged
events.doc: A sheet's frozen panes or row and column sizes changed.

events.name: StylesChanged
events.doc: Cells' styles changed.
